WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (Revised Edition 1956) as amended by Acts No. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions)Act No.37 of 1968 dated 07.02.2024 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No.2371/61 dated 17.02.2024 the Industrial Dispute in; respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour dated 16.01.2024. Mr. J. S. E. Karunaratne, B 2/32, Niyadagala, Meepitiya, Kegalle. and
People's Bank, Head Oﬃ ce, 12th Floor, No . 75, Sir Chittampalam A. Gardiner Mawatha, Colombo - 02.
was referred to Mr. R. Navodayam for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, due to Mr. R. Navodayam, the Arbitrator informing that he is resigning from this dispute, I, Manusha Nanayakkara, Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 07.02.2024.
